_comment: The single source of truth for the IndieOps Skilllet catalogue, published from the public indieops-co/skilllet-registry repo. Every guide's chooser is generated from this file at build time, and every downloaded guide quietly re-reads it (catalogueUrls, first that answers wins) to show anything released since.

brand.name: IndieOps
brand.signature: An IndieOps Skilllet — a copyable skill folder that does one job properly.
brand.termNote: Skilllet, three Ls. It is our word. Spelling it consistently is the cheapest brand asset we own.

_idRule: id is assigned once, at first public release, and never changes. Format: <release year>-<sequence within that year>. The version carries freshness; the id is a primary key. Re-stamping an id because something was revised destroys the only property that makes it an id.

_kindValues.skill: Copy a folder next to your work.
_kindValues.plugin: Install from a Claude Code plugin marketplace.
_kindValues.app: Also installs a program that runs on your computer (a background service or a desktop app).

_urlRule: A card links to the entry's url if it has one (https only), otherwise to <brand.url>/<slug>. 'previously' lists retired slugs so the site can redirect them.
_priceRule: No prices anywhere in the catalogue or the guides. A price baked into a static HTML file shipped to a buyer is a price you can never change — every launch discount, every increase, every free-week promo would need fifteen rebuilds and would still be wrong on every guide already downloaded. Pricing lives on the sales page, which is the only place it can be current.

skilllets.name: TastePilot
skilllets.problem: Your writing is good and it looks like a text file.
skilllets.does: Renders Markdown into designed HTML publications using Canons — swappable design grammars.

skilllets.name: OAuth Doctor
skilllets.problem: Your Google sign-in screen says "some-project-84f2b" and nobody trusts it.
skilllets.does: Diagnoses and polishes Google OAuth consent branding for Supabase and Firebase apps.

skilllets.name: Resend Ready
skilllets.problem: Your app needs to send email and you have never configured a sending domain.
skilllets.does: Takes a Next.js app from no email to sending — and optionally receiving — through Resend, with DNS verified.

skilllets.name: Press Ready
skilllets.problem: You are about to publish files carrying invisible characters and metadata you did not mean to send.
skilllets.does: Lossless pre-publish hygiene — invisible Unicode, file metadata, C2PA, whole folders at a time.

skilllets.name: Instantly Ready
skilllets.problem: Cold email infrastructure has nine moving parts and getting one wrong burns the domain.
skilllets.does: Walks a beginner from signup to a verified READY TO SEND state, with a bundled DNS checker.

skilllets.name: Claujabi
skilllets.problem: Course platforms want a monthly fee to host a thing you already made.
skilllets.does: Turns an outline or a pasted transcript into a distributable single-file HTML course with progress saved.

skilllets.name: Flipbook Maker
skilllets.problem: A long document nobody finishes reading.
skilllets.does: Converts text, markdown, a PDF, a post or a transcript into a self-contained interactive HTML flipbook.

skilllets.name: ApprovalPilot
skilllets.problem: A good plan-mode session dies when the context window does.
skilllets.does: At the plan-approval moment it shows how full your context is, says whether to hand off, and puts a complete handoff prompt on your clipboard.

skilllets.name: Reminder Router
skilllets.problem: Four AI sessions running and no idea which one needs you.
skilllets.does: A context-aware handoff utility that routes your attention to the project that actually stalled.

skilllets.name: Fable Cover
skilllets.problem: The story is written and the cover looks like clip art.
skilllets.does: Turns a fable title and a few details into image prompts that produce one coherent storybook cover.

skilllets.name: Memvana
skilllets.problem: Four thousand screenshots and a Notes app you have not opened in a year.
skilllets.does: Reads the pile and works out what you were actually trying to remember.

skilllets.name: LinkPanther
skilllets.problem: Your links are on somebody else's domain and you cannot change where they point.
skilllets.does: Works out the most branded URL architecture your domain can safely support, then builds and runs it.

skilllets.name: GBPCoach
skilllets.problem: Google Maps decides whether a local business gets called, and nobody explains how.
skilllets.does: Learns a business once, grades its Google Business Profile, and hands over three things to do this week with the copy already written.

skilllets.name: GBPCoach Pro
skilllets.problem: You can see your own profile. You cannot see what the businesses beating you have done.
skilllets.does: Adds live Maps data via your own API key — category intelligence, competitor files, review benchmarking, a client-ready monthly report.

skilllets.name: Client Library
skilllets.problem: Every Skilllet asks you the same six questions about the same business.
skilllets.does: One plain-Markdown library on your machine that every IndieOps Skilllet reads and writes. Install it once and they stop asking.

skilllets.name: CaveMaxx
skilllets.problem: You asked a question and got an essay when a diagram would have done.
skilllets.does: Teaches Claude to notice when a chart, calculator, comparison or mini-app would serve you better than prose, and to build that instead.

skilllets.name: Pilot-Pilot
skilllets.problem: Your script reads like everybody else's AI script.
skilllets.does: An AI writer's room: learns your voice, develops the story, writes for the format, then hunts down the AI slop before your audience does.

skilllets.name: QuestionPilot
skilllets.problem: Claude Code asks a question and the picker grabs your terminal before you've had a chance to think.
skilllets.does: Catches Claude Code's questions first, so you can read them, copy them, and decide what happens next.

skilllets.name: PromptAwesome
skilllets.problem: Every AI tool wants its prompts shaped differently, and yours are scattered across notes apps.
skilllets.does: A prompt library that lives in your repo. It asks the few questions that change the output, shapes the prompt for the tool you're pasting into, and keeps every version.
